**Article Details for PMID: 42998247**

**Title:** Initial Diabetes Therapy After Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting and Long-Term Outcomes.

**Authors:** Vincy Tam, Hartzell V Schaff, Viengneesee Thao, Holly Van Houten, Robert L Frye, Kevin L Greason, Yazan N AlJamal, Philip J Spencer, Philip G Rowse, Juan A Crestanello

**Journal:** Journal of the American Heart Association
**Publication Date:** 2026-11-07
**DOI:** 10.1161/JAHA.126.053850

**Abstract:**
Type 2 diabetes (T2D) is common among patients undergoing coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG), but optimal post-CABG glucose-lowering therapy remains uncertain.

**Note:** Full text is not available in PubMed Central. You may need institutional access or subscription to view the complete article.
